title: The Unlit Lantern Gate
story: The stone gate in the orchard opened only at dusk, and only when someone arrived with an unlit lantern. Mira carried hers carefully, because a flame would keep the gate shut. On the far side she found a garden where the fruit glowed faintly and a path repaired itself behind her. She picked one pear, left a ribbon, and stepped back before the stones closed.

vocabulary.definition: A piece of land where fruit trees grow.
The time when daylight is fading.
The bright burning part of a fire.
In a way that is soft and weak.
Mended so that it was whole again.

quiz.question: At what time of day could the stone gate open?
options: Only at dusk
Only at dawn
Whenever a flame was near
After the stones had closed
quiz.explanation: The gate opened only at dusk, and only for someone with an unlit lantern.
quiz.supportingSentence: The stone gate in the orchard opened only at dusk, and only when someone arrived with an unlit lantern.

quiz.question: What was Mira avoiding by carrying the lantern so carefully?
options: A flame that would stop the gate from opening
Fruit that would stop glowing if she hurried
A path that would push her back outside
A ribbon that would close the stones early
quiz.correctAnswer: A flame that would stop the gate from opening
quiz.explanation: She carried the lantern carefully because a flame would keep the gate shut.
quiz.supportingSentence: Mira carried hers carefully, because a flame would keep the gate shut.

quiz.question: Why did Mira step back when she did?
options: She needed to leave before the gate shut her in
She wanted to pick a second pear
She had forgotten to bring the ribbon
She wanted a flame to light the garden
quiz.correctAnswer: She needed to leave before the gate shut her in
quiz.explanation: She stepped back before the stones closed, so she would not be shut on the far side.
quiz.supportingSentence: She picked one pear, left a ribbon, and stepped back before the stones closed.

quiz.question: What does unlit mean in this story?
options: Not burning
Closed until morning
Shining with a strong light
Carried in both hands
quiz.explanation: An unlit lantern has no flame, which is the condition the gate requires.
quiz.supportingSentence: The stone gate in the orchard opened only at dusk, and only when someone arrived with an unlit lantern.

quiz.question: Why did Mira arrive with an unlit lantern?
options: She was meeting the condition that opens the gate
She was trying to set the orchard alight
She wanted the stones to close at once
She hoped to hide the glowing fruit
quiz.correctAnswer: She was meeting the condition that opens the gate
quiz.explanation: The gate opens only for someone who arrives with an unlit lantern, and that is what she carries.
quiz.supportingSentence: The stone gate in the orchard opened only at dusk, and only when someone arrived with an unlit lantern.
